The '''AE318 swoop engine''' was a model of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] produced by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]]. The [[Nebulon-Q Swoop Racer]] was equipped with such an engine.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
